text:
hannah: short async follow-up from the postmortem on the cross-region key propagation race. capturing owners + tiny ETAs. please ack and add gaps.

raj: ack. i'll own the validation hardening and the canary metric guard.

marta: ack. i'll own the rotation propagation verifier + gating hook.

li: ack. i'll take audit enrichment and alerting.

hannah: concise action list (B1..B6):
- B1: stricter token validation in auth-gateway (sig+kid+exp + explicit KMS key version check) — owner: raj — ETA: 12d
- B2: rotation-propagation verifier job: confirm KMS/HSM key version present in all regions + edge caches invalidated — owner: marta — ETA: 10d
- B3: gating rule for rotation PRs that requires verifier success and a 30m propagation watch in canary regions — owner: marta — ETA: 10d
- B4: audit log enrichment (include key_version, propagation_latency_ms) + retention 60d — owner: li — ETA: 5d
- B5: surface propagation failures in alerting dashboard + runbook link (page at propagation_failures > 1 / 30m or validation spike >0.4%) — owner: li — ETA: 7d
- B6: emergency feature-flag toggle to bypass new keys for <1h for fast rollback if propagation fails — owner: infra (ops-bot) — ETA: 4d to stage flag

marta: verifier plan sketch: 
1) preflight: query KMS API for key versions in all regions, verify replica versions match primary
2) post-rotate: run propagation smoke that hits auth-gateway through edge cache and verifies token exchange succeeds in each region
3) watch: 30m canary window where validation.failure_rate and propagation_latency are monitored
4) rollback: auto-flag rollback + post-mortem trigger if any region fails more than 2 checks

example preflight command (CI):
```
# fails if any region missing the expected version
kms-cli get-key-version --key=auth-signing-key --regions=us-west-2,eu-west-1,ap-south-1 | jq '.versions' | grep "v42" || exit 1
```

raj: validation hardening detail: add explicit key_version check and metric validation.key_version_mismatch. integration test example: 
```
POST /auth/validate
{ "token": "eyJ...uses-v41" }
expect: 401, emit metric: validation.key_version_mismatch
```
ETA for PR: 2024-08-06. i'll canary for 48h then full rollout.

li: audit proposal: add fields key_version, propagation_latency_ms, edge_cache_hit=false/true. sampling 40% for 30d, retention 60d. saved queries: propagation_lag_1h, validation_spike_15m. PR: 2024-07-31.

ops-bot: Calendar "rotation-propagation-checks" created weekly (Thurs 10:00 PT) for 6-week cadence. Ticket ROT-9991 created and assigned to marta.

hannah: recurrence note: ops scanned last year and observed 5 events clustered around major vendor cert rotations and scheduled KMS maintenance windows; propagation lag + stale edge caches were common contributors. this remediation aims to cover both KMS replication and CDN/edge cache invalidation.

marta: gating detail: verifier must return success + no propagation_latency > 5s in canary regions. if gate fails, block merge and mark PR with status: "propagation-failed". will implement as a required status check.

li: alerting detail: page SRE when propagation_failures > 1 in 30m OR validation.failure_rate > 0.4% sustained 15m. also post lower severity notifications to #rotations for 0.2% / 15m. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/key-propagation.md

ops-bot: Feature flag "ff.new-key-tmp-bypass" created in staging. Will promote to prod gating in 4d if no objections.

hannah: owners please add label "incident-2955550000-remediate" to PRs and paste links here. i'll update the remediation spreadsheet and run a sync in 1 week.

marta: verifier PR (WIP): https://redwood.internal/pull/5432 target merge 2024-08-05.

raj: validation PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/5436 (draft). ETA 2024-08-06.

li: audit/dashboard PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/5434 (ready). ETA 2024-07-31.

hannah: timeline recap: B4 -> 5d, B6 -> 4d, B2+B3 -> 10d, B1 -> 12d, B5 -> 7d. weekly propagation checks for 6 weeks; escalate to incident review if >1 production propagation failure in that window.

marta: will include edge purge step in verifier: purge CDN path /auth/keys/* and verify new key visible within 60s.

raj: will add metric alert for validation.key_version_mismatch and link to PR.

li: will wire dashboard tile and saved queries.

ops-bot: Reminder created: rotation-propagation-check next run 2024-07-25T10:00:00-07:00.

hannah: thanks all. closing this thread after spreadsheet updated and PR links confirmed. :thumbsup:
